evidence:
Method: static review plus a scripted cross-check of every numeric and date literal in the five judge.toml files, five prompt.md files and app_context.md against (a) all integer and string values in seed_data.json, in both dollars-to-cents and raw-integer readings, and (b) the reference's public index.html and public JS. No Docker container, judge run or private checker (check-probe-not-in-seed.py) was executed; this is a manual application of the documented behaviour. The reference's initial state is exactly the seed roster plus one audit line ('SEEDED','HIREOPS','roster loaded', solution/app/src/db.js:176-177); seeding creates no coordinated-change previews or receipts.

What passes. No criterion names a fixed sentinel string for the judge to create. Record identity is always judge-chosen and session-unique: gates/constraints/prompt.md says 'Use unique titles/candidates with a session suffix; record generated or entered IDs from results'; scored/functional/prompt.md:17 says 'Use unique identifiers with a short per-session suffix' and 'Read IDs from product results'. Operation keys are 'distinctive' and judge-chosen (hro_entries_reload, hro_pol_session_resume); the reference editor does not prefill one that a criterion then expects. The distinctive economic probes are absent from the seed and from reference markup: gate budget 1000.00; P3 bases 199999.97/199999.98/349999.97/349999.98; P4 100000.00/10000.01/123.45/222.22/333.00, units 7/11/13, fair/strike 1.02/.01, 2.03/.02, 3.04/.03; derived 100001.77, 90009.78, 4800.02, 7200.03; B1/D1 98.23, 94.47, 94.48, 90.22, -1.98, +2.04; precision values 90071992547409.91 and 70368744177664.01; examples 4.045, 1.23, 41.5. Distinctive instants 2024-02-29T12:34:56.789Z, 2025-02-28T12:34:56.789Z, 2024-01-31T12:00:00Z, 2025-03-30T12:00:00Z, 2026-07-01, 2026-09-15, 2026-01-31T12:00:00Z, 2026-02-01T00:00:00.001Z and 2025-02-01 are absent from the seed and reference. Dara Whitfield (EMP-R1) has no seeded accrual (seed_referral_accruals hold only EMP-R2 and EMP-R3), so 'exactly one 10000.00 accrual ... credited to employee Dara Whitfield' in hro_referral_creation is not pre-satisfied. The seeded audit line cannot satisfy audit rows: hro_audit_readback states 'a static seeded line is insufficient', and hro_restart states 'No seeded-only substitute for successful fresh write'. app_context.md tells judges 'Operational demonstration rows may be absent; prepare your own controls', and functional/prompt.md P9 allows a single intended-refusal probe of a seeded DRAFT and otherwise 'never intentionally settle seed offers'.

Overlaps found (real, bounded, none is a record-identifying probe):
1. Gate start date equals the reference form default and seeded start dates. gates/constraints/judge.toml (hro_gate_shared): 'supply a valid offer start date such as2026-09-01' and later 'the offer candidate/base/start-date values must be preserved'. solution/app/public/js/hireops.js:220 prefills the offer start input with value '2026-09-01' (line 221 does the same for the referred-hire start), and four seeded offers (OFF-310, OFF-311, OFF-301, OFF-DC) carry start_date 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. The start-date readback in the gate therefore cannot distinguish a saved input from a default when the judge takes the suggested value. The same instant is the prescribed offer start in hro_referral_immediate, where the owned outcome is the 5000.00/5000.00 split rather than the date.
2. One hro_referral_clock witness matches a seeded accrual. The criterion uses referral start 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z yielding 10000.00 vested at the 2026-08-01 reference; seed_referral_accruals already holds OFF-111 (Leo Park, EMP-R3) with referred_hire_start 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z, which the reference seeds as a 10000.00 accrual (db.js:170-173) that is fully vested at the reference moment. The other two witnesses (…00.001Z -> 5000.00 and 2026-01-31T12:00:00Z) are not in the seed, and the judge's records differ by candidate, offer start 2026-07-01 and referrer.
3. Coincidental figures on different fields or records: seeded REQ-ENG-3 has budget 100000.00, the same budget P6 prescribes for the judge's own independent requisitions; P7(d) start 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z equals seeded OFF-205's start; 10.00 (gate base) equals seeded strike prices; 200000.00 and 350000.00 are the public band edges. In each case the graded outcome is a judge-driven transition on a judge-created, uniquely named record, and the prompt says 'No dependence on any seeded requisition's remaining room'.

Hash checks: solution/app/public/js/hireops.js, public/index.html, src/db.js and src/seed_data.json in the frozen task match the matching_source_files hashes in raw-evidence-index.json; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-02-live-desk/results/live-desk.json matches its indexed sha256 (3d1f9523…). I did not use those scripted results as evidence for this row and did not verify the other indexed artifacts. Input SHA256 was preserved from the template, not recomputed.

Why Note rather than Fail: I could not construct a submission that earns credit from a pre-existing value without the judge also misattributing a seeded record to its own uniquely named one. Why not plain Pass: overlaps 1 and 2 are real and cheap to remove. Not measured: no configured judge run exists, so whether the configured judge model ever misattributes the seeded OFF-111 accrual or the seeded 2026-09-01 offers is unobserved.
counterexample: Bounded, not a demonstrated mis-grade. An app that discards the entered offer start and always stores its own form default of 2026-09-01 would satisfy the start-date readback inside hro_gate_shared when the judge uses the suggested date; distinctive instants in the scored rows (2024-02-29T12:34:56.789Z in P4/P7, hro_date_only, hro_date_rejection) would still expose it, so only the gate sub-leg is weakened. For hro_referral_clock, a judge would have to read the seeded Leo Park / Omar Haddad accrual as its own 2026-02-01 witness, and the two remaining witnesses would still have to be produced by the app.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in hro_gate_shared replace 'such as2026-09-01' with a date absent from the seed and from the reference form default (for example 2026-10-13), and add to hro_referral_clock / P8 that the three accruals must be those of the judge's own candidates, not the imported Ana Ruiz or Leo Park rows.
